captions.detailed: This 3D model features a rustic, open-sided wooden belfry with a gabled timber frame roof and a solid platform base. Inside the structure, two bronze-colored bells of different sizes hang side-by-side from horizontal wooden headstock beams. Each bell is mounted to its respective support with a central pin, allowing it to swing independently back and forth along a revolute joint axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a two-bell open belfry with a gabled timber frame. The structure should feature two bronze bells of different sizes hung side-by-side, each attached to its own headstock beam via a revolute joint to swing independently.
captions.factory: The code constructs a timber frame belfry using Box primitives for the base, vertical pillars, support beams, and rafters arranged to form a gabled roof. The bells are modeled using a combination of Cylinder primitives for the pins and custom rotational shapes (or truncated cones) for the bell bodies. It defines a base 'belfry' part for the wooden structure, and two separate moving 'bell' parts, connecting each to the frame using independent revolute articulations with horizontal rotation axes.
